This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.6287 of 2025, "State vs. Pradeep Pant", pending before the court of learned Ist Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Ist Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel for the applicant and Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal,
learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.
3.

Mr. Suryakant Maithani, Advocate, has submitted that the applicant was married to the respondent no.2 - informant and an Original Suit (No.1384 of 2024) was filed by him under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
The said suit has been decreed ex-parte by learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Dehradun on 03.11.2025.
4. Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2.

Steps to be taken within a week.
5. List on 19.03.2026.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.6287 of 2025 are stayed.
6. The applicant and the respondent no.2 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 19.03.2026.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 05.01.2026 Pant/
